summary: Switch from top-2 to Switch-style top-1 routing for sparse-MoE workload
rationale: Top-1 routing eliminates secondary expert path, reducing A2A traffic and token rerouting
Simplifies capacity calculation and expert assignment logic
Expected to reduce step time by removing secondary token handling overhead
Maintains packed variable-length dispatch and SDPA attention from previous rounds
expected_effects: tokens_rerouted should drop to 0.0 (no secondary routing)
estimated_a2a_bytes should decrease due to single expert per token
step_time_s should improve toward the 30.1693s baseline from round 1
load_balance_cv may change due to different routing distribution
risks: Top-1 routing may increase tokens_dropped if capacity is too tight
Model quality may differ from top-2 baseline (acceptable for benchmark)
Validation logic needed update to allow top_k=1
